title: The Philosophy of Flow — A Trading Manifesto
author: James Gilbert

core_beliefs.name: The Cascade
core_beliefs.statement: Capital flows like water. BTC moves first. Large caps follow. Small caps pump last. The cascade is inevitable.
core_beliefs.implication: Don't predict. Observe. Position at the ledge. Wait for the water.

core_beliefs.name: The Temporal Lag
core_beliefs.statement: There is a 3-day lag from BTC to large caps. A 7-day lag from large caps to small caps. A 3-week lag from BTC dump to alt crash.
core_beliefs.implication: Markets have memory. Time is the edge.

core_beliefs.name: The Spillway
core_beliefs.statement: Exhaustion precedes the crash. Euphoria signals the top. The spillway forms before the flood recedes.
core_beliefs.implication: Exit while others are still euphoric. Never wait for the crash.

core_beliefs.name: The Flow
core_beliefs.statement: Fighting the river exhausts you. Riding it moves you. The market is not an enemy. It is water.

trading_laws: No entry without BTC confirmation — the cascade doesn't start without the first drop
Respect the temporal lag — don't chase, let the water come to you
Exit before euphoria peaks — leave the last 10% for the greedy
The system runs on autopilot while you build the next thing
